Do you like Sam and Nick together?
Who did you like interacting with the most?

nodes.text: Nick has failed.
Lesson learned! Asking permission is always better than getting a broken camera...
Try again and see if you can get Nick on the right track!

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Nick raises his camera and takes a picture!
But his flash goes off!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What was that?
Before Nick can react quickly enough, Ryan rounds the car and finds Nick. He grabs Nick's collar.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You. Weird emo Spartan. What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Taking a picture?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why'd you do a stupid thing like that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I... Uh... You were crying.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Was not!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Okay. You weren't crying? Look, there was a really good photo opportunity, and I took it, and I'm asking for your forgiveness...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I know what this is. You think you can get a picture of a tough guy looking weak, huh?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Maybe you want to show it off to your emo friends...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, you know what? That's `weird`, and you're going to pay for it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you know what? That's [color=#e23b3b][i]weird[/i][/color], and you're going to pay for it!

nodes.text: Ryan grabs Nick's camera.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait, that's really expensive, I...
Ryan smashes the camera down on the ground, and it shatters! Bits of plastic and glass shatter all over the floor.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Try taking a picture without that!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: ...Oh wait, you `can't.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Oh wait, you [color=#e23b3b][i]can't.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: See you, sucker.
Ryan walks off, and Nick goes to collect the pieces of his camera.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Hello?
Ryan straightens up quickly!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Who's there?!
Nick steps out from behind the car.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to... Interrupt.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What are you doing here? No one's at school right now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm with the school newspaper. I was trying to do an article on the earthquake... How it's been affecting students.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Okay. I don't care. Go away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I was wondering if you'd mind if I took a picture of you.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You seem to be very affected.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No, I don't!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I mean... You just seem very sad.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, the earthquake kind of shocked me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It shocked a lot of us.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But you don't understand. It made me `think` about things.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you don't understand. It made me [color=#e23b3b][i]think[/i][/color] about things.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I assume you don't do that often.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No! I hate it! A huge rock almost fell on me! If I hadn't dodged it, I would have `died!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I hate it! A huge rock almost fell on me! If I hadn't dodged it, I would have [color=#e23b3b][i]died![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Can you imagine? Dying right now? In the prime of my life?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, it's not quite the prime of...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: In the `prime of my life?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In the [color=#e23b3b][i]prime of my life?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I have a whole list of things I want to do before I kick the bucket...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Like hit on all the waitresses at the mall food court...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's, uh... Weird.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Or make out with up to `three` insecure girls at `one` party...
nodes.text_bbcode: Or make out with up to [color=#e23b3b][i]three[/i][/color] insecure girls at [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] party...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's wrong.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Or climb to the top of a mountain...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's... Surprisingly normal?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And make out with triplets on the peak!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I should have guessed...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What if I'd never fulfilled the list? What kind of a life is that?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Truly, a live unlived.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So why do you want a picture?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Your story is very touching. I think it would make a lot of people see the way you felt.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: A lot of girls you mean?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I actually meant people, but yeah, girls too.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'll do it! I'll pose for the paper! Okay, where do you want me to be?
A few minutes later, Nick has his picture and makes his way into the school.
Primed with new instructions, the girls pose for the camera once again.
Some of them are sad, some are concerned, and some are angry with the state of the events after the earthquake.
After a few minutes, Nick puts his camera down.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You were all great!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Of course we were!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: These pictures will really move people.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think I'm actually starting to see the point of having cheerleaders around.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good, whatever! Just make sure we get pictured near the Presidential candidates.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure!
Nick walks away from the group excitedly.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I forgot how much I missed taking pictures!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now to find the rebels!
Primed with new instructions, the girls pose for the camera once again.
Some of them smile widely, some tilt their head attractively, and others make smooching motions with their mouths.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't want them to make `duck faces`... This is going to be a terrible picture to run with the earthquake article!
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't want them to make [color=#e23b3b][i]duck faces[/i][/color]... This is going to be a terrible picture to run with the earthquake article!

nodes.text: After taking a few pictures, Nick puts his camera down.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're done already? I want to see the pictures!
The cheerleaders crowd around the camera's viewing window to check themselves out.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Awesome! I look totally hot!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We look like we're ready to party!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I feel like I just figured out what's wrong with the world...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, Nick, can you text this picture to me? I want to put it on Faceplace!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll see what I can do...
Nick walks away.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That was a disaster... Hopefully things will go better tomorrow with the rebel group...
The next afternoon, Nick walks through the school parking lot towards the Auto Shop when he hears a curious sound from behind a truck.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It sounds like... Someone's sobbing?
Quietly, Nick approaches the sound. Hiding behind a car, he peers around it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's... Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...
Despite the surprising situation, Nick can't help but notice what a great picture it would make.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, like I'd ever `forget.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, like I'd ever [color=#3b78e2][i]forget.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Perfect...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just remember what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... The first time Ben kissed you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And Jessica... Just remember when...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, sure...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Perfect...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Bewildered?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Give me...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, anything but that...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's the look I want when I take the picture...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, I love those!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And unicorns make me think of horses, and horses make me think of rainbows! I love all those things!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not the look I was going for...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... A happy unicorn?
Nick finds the cheerleaders practicing elsewhere in the park.
Jessica directs from underneath the shade of a gazebo, sipping a fruity drink.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maria, higher kicks! Just because you lost your uniform in the school locker room, doesn't mean you can kick like a four-year-old!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole, Amanda, and $ZOE... Arms up!
The cheerleaders in question are holding up three big signs with the letters 'B', 'E', and 'N' written on them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we've been doing this for twenty minutes straight!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I think I lost my arms...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, fine, you whiners. Put them down! Bring it in! You get a five minute break!
As the cheerleaders relax, Nick walks up to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, uh... Emo Guy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's Nick actually.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, sure. So what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you mind if I take a few photos of you and the cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh. Creepy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, not like that! It's for school.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't tell me you're taking pictures for a stupid newspaper article...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Actually, I am...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Lame! You're boring me. And I don't have time to be bored.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's already bad enough that I'm doing way more work than I have to because of that stupid earthquake.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I mean, have you tried being the most popular girl at school when `there is no school?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, have you tried being the most popular girl at school when [color=#3b78e2][i]there is no school?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She takes a forceful sip of her drink.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wow, you don't hold back do you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Look, I know this article doesn't seem that important, but it'll give you all a little publicity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Does it look like we need publicity?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What if I say you're picture will get prime real estate, opposite the page on the Presidential nominees...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The Presidential nominees?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, uh, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then what's a little picture between strangers? The cheerleaders will be happy to help!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... Why don't you girls position yourselves over by the gazebo?
The cheerleaders get into position and stare at the camera.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm all ready for my close up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, if this is for an article about the earthquake... Are we supposed to smile?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, what's my motivation?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, this photo is supposed to reflect your feelings after the earthquake, so the simplest question would be...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How did you feel after the earthquake?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Really sad!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was shaken up! I was worried about people getting hurt.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I felt helpless! My boyfriend was stuck inside the school, and I couldn't do anything about it!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And those emotions are exactly what I want to capture. Channel that into the picture...
As soon as Nick raises his camera, the cheerleaders strike poses.
Some of them smile uncertainly, some look wide-eyed, others purse their lips together to look more attractive.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Looks like it'll take more than knowing how they feel to get them to pose just right...
Nick lowers his camera and walks over to the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let's try something else. Pretend you're all models...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I like where this is going...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes, well... Think about things that make you feel the way you did when I asked you about the earthquake earlier...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: For instance, Amanda, think about...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Okay!
Zach leaps up onto the highest point on the log and stands up straight and tall. The other jocks follow suit.
With the sun's light and the breeze in the air, the football players make a heroic sight.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, we look kind of awesome up here.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's kind of the point...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It's like we're pro football players!
Zach pumps his fists in the air excitedly as Nick starts snapping pictures of the group.
A little while later...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...And that's it!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You should be able to see the article on our school website at the end of the week.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I can't wait!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm going to look killer!
The guys pat Nick on the back as they walk back to practice.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That wasn't so bad. Now for the cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Make it look like you're doing some work.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I don't know... I hate splinters!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't be a wuss. Come on.
Led by Zach, the football team lifts the log.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, now look heroic!
The football players smile at the camera, and Nick begins snapping pictures...
When suddenly, Phil starts squirming!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What are you doing? Stop that! You're making my grip slip on the log!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'm trying, but there's... There's something wriggling down my back!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually, I feel something crawling on my hand!
The boys look down and realize the log has a huge swarm of ants on it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ah!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! They're biting me with their tiny teeth!
They drop the log, and it comes crashing down on their feet!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Not my toes! `Ahhh!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not my toes! [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahhh!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A few minutes later, the football players manage to extricate themselves from the log.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So, uh... Do you want to take another picture?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! Photography sucks!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Nick. You should probably just go...
Nick turns away from the football players...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Geez, that guy is so `weird...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Geez, that guy is so [color=#e23b3b][i]weird...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, there's always the cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So what do you think about the job?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, I don't know how easy it'll be getting people to pose for pictures... The earthquake is pretty fresh in their minds...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I can try...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: In fact, I'll start right now!
Nick finds the football team in the woods behind the school.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...It sucks that we don't have the football field. How are we supposed to win our next game if our goal posts are pine trees?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah, tell me about it...
Nick approaches, camera in hand.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, football team! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What's it look like? We're doing football!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It was more of a rhetorical question, but... Thanks for answering.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey Nick, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The newspaper is doing an article on the aftermath of the earthquake, and I'm taking photos for it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Mind if I snap a picture of the football team to show how it's affected you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you want us to do, Nick?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We can tackle some dummies... Or tackle each other... Or sack Howard here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, well... As much as I want to prove everyone right about the violent tendencies of football... That's not the right look for the article.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How about instead we get a heroic shot of you guys after the earthquake?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: If we're going for heroics, we should ask Ben to be here. I heard he lifted a huge chunk of concrete off Denni!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I heard he was buried in the cafeteria and ate his way out!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was there, guys. He fought against a fire and won! Ben was actually brave!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: From what I've heard, you guys were all pretty brave. This picture should prove that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where should we take the picture?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Why don't you stand under those trees, near that fallen log?
The football players walk over. Nick is posing them around the log when he gets an idea.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It'd be great if they interacted with the log in some way. Maybe they should stand on it? Or better yet, lift it!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, guys, I have a great idea. Why don't you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Did you already hear about this story, Nick?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, but it's funny to imagine Brendan stepping out of his element by approaching the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, he hardly steps away from his computer!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, the story's pretty great...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Brendan gave the cheerleaders garden snakes to pose with for an article about saving endangered reptiles...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Naturally, none of them wanted to do it, so Brendan posed with a snake to show them it would be okay...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But then the snake slithered into his shirt, and as he twists around, he starts yelling, 'Nickelfurters! Nickelfurters!'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It was `hilarious!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It was [color=#3b78e2][i]hilarious![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They called me 'Nickelfurthers' for a month afterward!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's so... Funny? And tragic.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ha ha... Sorry, Nick. It's one of those stories that's probably better to the people inside than the people `outside.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha... Sorry, Nick. It's one of those stories that's probably better to the people inside than the people [color=#3b78e2][i]outside.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, sorry, Nick. Brendan tried to... He tried to...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There was a snake and then...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Nickelfurters!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't explain... It's just `too funny...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't explain... It's just [color=#3b78e2][i]too funny...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick nods as Denni and Angie collapse into a fit of laughter.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick. It's probably just one of those things that's only funny to us, and no one else `on the outside.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, Nick. It's probably just one of those things that's only funny to us, and no one else [color=#3b78e2][i]on the outside.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard puts an arm around $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, don't worry too much about it. We don't have to think about it for a while.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, I should take off. Football practice is starting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I should go too. Jessica hates it when people are late for cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Same with Coach Kessler. That guy never lets up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And... Break!
Howard and $ZOE walk towards the park, and Sam walks toward the swimming pool.
Nick watches all of them walk away, a sinking feeling in his stomach.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Even without an actual school building, they know where they're going and what they're doing...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They all seem to fit in...
Unsure what to do, Nick follows Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hanging out with you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, unless you're going to dive into the pool and start swimming laps, I don't think you can.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Coach Kessler doesn't like any of us 'having a boyfriend'. He doesn't like 'distractions', so he'll probably make me pay for it if you come.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It makes me feel kind of sorry for Sara Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But that's her deal.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Got it. Make the swim coach mad, get your girlfriend in trouble. Easy enough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, Sam, I was thinking it would be fun to go on a park date and take some pictures by the lake tomorrow afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, I can't... I have swim practice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But we can do that afterwards.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure. And the day after that I want to take you to this cafe down the street...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, okay... I guess... I'll have to see what I'm doing...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And the next day, there's a huge art exhibit opening down by the Centerscore Art Museum...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, `maybe`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]maybe[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And then after `that,` there's an awesome `silent movie` coming out...
nodes.text_bbcode: And then after [color=#e23b3b][i]that,[/i][/color] there's an awesome [color=#e23b3b][i]silent movie[/i][/color] coming out...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, stop!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're planning too many things!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm... Sorry?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I like you, but I don't want to hang out with you `every. Single. Day.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I like you, but I don't want to hang out with you [color=#3b78e2][i]every. Single. Day.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, wrong way to put it. But you know what I meant, right?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure... You know I'm still trying to learn the ropes around here, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know you're new, and we just managed to get everyone to accept the Spartan students...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But seriously, we don't always have to do everything together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And $ZOE and Howard could probably use a break from you too.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just think that you should make friends who share your interests and your totally, uh... Unique perspective of the world.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Finding friends in that sweet spot between emo and hipster is going to be hard, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'll figure it out. Get a new hobby... Like join an athletic team or... Get into a fight.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: A fight? I don't want to end up in detention!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, okay, bad idea. Isn't there something you could do with photography or something?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I... I guess I could find something.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thank you.
Sam kisses him on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll see you later.
She runs off.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Easier said than done... I don't really know anyone who could help me...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Except maybe for the newspaper club!
A few minutes later, Nick finds the newspaper club at their new meeting spot, Pepperoni Toni's Diner.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, so they haven't seen me in a while... That doesn't mean they've forgotten me entirely... Right?
Nick walks over to the table where Brendan, Denni, and Angie are sitting.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, hey guys...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nick! Good to see you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This is a very different newspaper studio than the one I saw last time.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's the smell of pizza, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And probably the lack of newspapers.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Unfortunately, after the earthquake struck our school, this seemed to be the best place to meet.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So what brings you here? Do you have any new secret conspiracy theories, or did you just want to sign my cast?
Denni brandishes the cast on her leg attractively.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Neither. And what makes you think I'd share all my secrets with you? What if you were in on the conspiracy?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Heh. Appropriately paranoid. Nice.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm looking for a new project, and newspaper club seemed like the place to come.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, the Presidential elections for next year are coming up soon...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You could take pictures of the candidates looking formal for the camera.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can do that... But I was kind of hoping for something a little bigger, something more... Journalistic.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, the article opposite the elections page is going to be about the aftermath of the earthquake at Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'd love it if you took photos for that.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure... What kind of photos? I could get images of the devastation to the school, or...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, it's not like that. This is a human interest piece. I want it to touch on everyone at Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The earthquake was a real blow to morale around here. We had just started to get some school identity, and then this terrible disaster happened.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know if you've noticed, but people are really hurting. Seeing our school go down in flames is not something that's entirely comforting.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's why I want to write something that will lift people's spirits.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's no reason why our newspaper couldn't be an outlet for expression of hope, of a vision for the future.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I'd like the images that accompany the article to be inspired, to really stick with students, and send them a positive message.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can get behind that.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And to think... I was just looking for a way to pass the time while Sam swam...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Glad we could help! Remember, go for emotion. Get in with people and ask them about their experiences.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And go for variety. Get pictures of all the cliques!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, sure. I don't have that many contacts, though...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're the guy that stood up to The Immortals! Asking people to take pictures should be a cinch.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I suppose when you put it like that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You'll be fine! Anything is better than that one time Brendan totally flubbed getting the cheerleaders to pose for a piece on reptilian conservation we were writing back then.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ha ha! I remember that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, dealing with the cheerleaders is nerve-wracking! You don't know what they're hiding behind their judgmental pom-poms.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And do you remember what happened after that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ha ha! That was pretty funny... Even if it did happen to me.
Nick watches them laugh.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about not getting to see each other every day and having to talk to each other on the phone and not being involved in each other's daily lives?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, yeah... I mean, there are those aspects of it. But what about the other things?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Well, you'll each get time to grow independently as people and cultivate new interests and make new friends...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Without being shackled by the other person.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm shackling Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, of course not!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, `what are you saying?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nick, [color=#3b78e2][i]what are you saying?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You two will be fine?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's what you went with?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, hear me out...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: From what I know, they're hard to maintain...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But if you both resolve to talk to each other every day and really be a part of each other's lives...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then a long distance relationship is exactly what you need to grow closer as a couple.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Did that help?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A little...
Nick sweeps dust, clears debris, and sorts tools until his hands are red and his muscles ache!
Some time later...
Nick throws the last piece of rubble into the dumpster!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's it!
Megan and Kenji join him in front of the dumpster, and they all admire their handiwork.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You don't seem so bad, Skinny Jeans. We owe you one.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm just glad I could help. Do you mind if I take a picture of your guys in your good-as-new Auto-Shop?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sure. Whatever.
Megan and Kenji climb up to the top of the large trash pile they've made.
Nick snaps a picture of them grinning triumphantly atop huge remnants of the ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: These before-and-after shots will tell a fantastic story.
Nick hurries out, elated.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This is going really smoothly! Tomorrow, I see what the nerds are up to!

menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Nick, we saw the picture you put into the article...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, how's that working out for you guys?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not good, man. The slogan didn't work!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: People think they're a joke...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Maybe we `should` have avoided those puns... If only we knew before!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe we [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] have avoided those puns... If only we knew before!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Now we're going to have to scramble to get enough people together for even a `decent` party...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now we're going to have to scramble to get enough people together for even a [color=#e23b3b][i]decent[/i][/color] party...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, guys...
They walk away from Nick, sorting out various strategies.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, and we have a few words to say to you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Don't doctor our pictures ever again! You're terrible at it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You didn't like the enhanced lighting?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: It made us look frightened and weak. And the thing Denni wrote about us was even worse! She says the tragedy still haunts some students today.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah. With the mood lighting and the article, people have started to feel sorry for us!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You could embrace it... Ryan seems to enjoy pity...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Dextrous Shadowguard would kill a man for such mockery!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...Unfortunately as I am not he, I will just complain about it quietly to your face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry it didn't work out...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Just don't do us any more favors in the future...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, did you read that stupid article in the newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't keep up with the news. Why? Did that emo guy actually get us in?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No. Worse. The article says that it seems that 'no defineable progress on the school can be seen so far'...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So it means we're never going to see any progress done on the Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey, we cleaned it up yesterday... Until `someone` messed it all up again.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, we cleaned it up yesterday... Until [color=#e23b3b][i]someone[/i][/color] messed it all up again.

nodes.text: From his vantage spot, Nick shrinks against a wall.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'm just saying. It's going to be a long time before we see any improvements to this dump.
They walk off.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, that was depressing...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't see our picture, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The article does mention us...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that's about it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you sure? That emo guy promised we'd be `shown` in the newspaper!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure? That emo guy promised we'd be [color=#3b78e2][i]shown[/i][/color] in the newspaper!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know that he `promised` it...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know that he [color=#3b78e2][i]promised[/i][/color] it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We were supposed to be in a featured article right next to the announcement of the open Presidential nominations.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm not represented at all! When I find that guy, I'm going to wring his neck! Where `is` he?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not represented at all! When I find that guy, I'm going to wring his neck! Where [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] he?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh-oh!
Nick ducks around a corner.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Denni must have left their picture out...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Which makes sense since it wasn't that appropriate for the material...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Dude, did you guys read what she said about us?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Do I look like I read? All I know is that stupid picture is stupid!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, listen, this is the line underneath it.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: 'The tremendous loss of the earthquake was difficult to handle, leaving many students fragile and vulnerable...'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Fragile?!` I'm not `fragile!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Fragile?![/i][/color] I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]fragile![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah! The picture makes us look weak! Phil, what's up with that scared look?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I had a man-eating beetle running down my back! What was I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Not all of us can have a dumb smile on like Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's not a smile. That's a `grimace` from the log `falling on my foot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not a smile. That's a [color=#e23b3b][i]grimace[/i][/color] from the log [color=#e23b3b][i]falling on my foot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe I shouldn't have submitted that picture...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I'm out of ideas.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think I know what slogan I want to go with...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I expect to see our most amazing one on there.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, don't `crush` this party before it even gets started.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, don't [color=#e23b3b][i]crush[/i][/color] this party before it even gets started.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wouldn't dream of it. Are you ready for your photo op?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I was born ready.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, I was going to say that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Me too. That's why we're the `Bro-Migos!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Me too. That's why we're the [color=#e23b3b][i]Bro-Migos![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, on three! 1... 2... 3!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Bro-Migos!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Bro-Migos!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `Bro-Migos!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Bro-Migos![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick takes the picture.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, guys! I got it from here.
They walk off, arguing party logistics.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And I think I'm done for the today... I've got a good sampling from most of the cliques, I think...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I got another one... 'Got tremors? Come to our party!'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay! Enough! I don't think any of those slogans are going to work.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I said no earthquake puns, and that seems to be all I'm hearing.
Carson loops his arm around Nick.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Nick, hear us out. If all we're giving you are earthquake puns, it's because that's what we think works.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Don't question the method.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just the man?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not that either.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, guys, let's just all calm down. Nick, take our picture, use our slogans... I promise you, it'll all work out.
Nick sighs and snaps a picture of the three Bro-Migos.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Remember what we talked about!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now that the party posters are settled, let's go back to talking about the important things! Fog machines anyone?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You and your machines, man...
$Scott, Carson, and Hector walk off, arguing party logistics.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... I hope they enjoy their slogans. At least that's the last group for the today...
Later, Nick finds Denni hanging out at Pepperoni Toni's.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Done already?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It helps when people are interested in the subject matter.
Nick hands her a stack of photos.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great! I'll take a look through them and see what I can use.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know, Nick, thanks so much for doing this. I'd actually have done more myself, but...
She looks sadly down at her cast.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Leg issues...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm really excited to see these. You know, if these pictures are even half as good as I think they are, then this could be a full-time position for you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let me know what you think.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You can see for yourself when the article comes out tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, Denni.
After school the next day, Nick mills around outside the mobile classrooms while students all around him check the school newspaper on their phones...
To his left, Nick overhears the football players...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Good!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No for multiple reasons.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Awww...
Nick stares blankly at Carson.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm taking that look on your face as pure acceptance.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: 'Get your `crush` on at a good old fashioned `shakedown!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Get your [color=#e23b3b][i]crush[/i][/color] on at a good old fashioned [color=#e23b3b][i]shakedown!'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait, isn't that a little punny?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nah...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: But it's got nothing on this one...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Most definitely not.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ha ha! Yours has got nothing on this one...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, sure, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'Get rid of the shakes at our aftershock afterparty!'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... Maybe one less 'good', but that's perfect.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But wait... I got it...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, wait... I got it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... No.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: 'Get down with good music, good friends, and good times'!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That one works. I can put that one on your picture.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hey, wait, I got another one!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: He's right, $Scott. We need something snappier like...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hm... I don't know about that one...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What about 'You're invited to the dance party of the century'?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey wait, if you like that one...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let's shy away from reminding people what happened.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, guys. I'll see what I can do then.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, nerds down...
Nick turns to leave the arcade when he runs into $Scott, Carson, and Hector talking and joking around.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It'd be great to get these guys in the article too!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...I've thrown a few in my time. But the best was Amanda's. Before we were dating, I threw a Russian New Year's Party, just so I could kiss her!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We do crazy things for love.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I totally relocated my Summer Solstice party to my dad's private tropical island just because I wanted to impress someone.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Private tropical island?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah. It's small, but fashionable... Like an accessory island.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And Summer Solstice? Is that a holiday?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You don't know about Summer Solstice, the time where you wear all white and go from door-to-door bearing apples?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That sounds like anti-Halloween.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Huh. I didn't think about it quite like that, but sure.
Nick approaches the group.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, party crew.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What's up, Nicholas?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know, that's not actually my name. Percy just called me that for his own personal amusement.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh... I didn't realize. That makes sense, considering Percy `was` a pretentious jerk. What I meant to say was... What's up, Nick?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... I didn't realize. That makes sense, considering Percy [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] a pretentious jerk. What I meant to say was... What's up, Nick?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm getting some information for a newspaper article about the earthquake. Mind if I get you guys on film?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: This guy loves the camera.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So does this one.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And me too!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh geez.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But hey, man, if you're going to take a picture, want to do us a favor?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone at school's been down since the earthquake... We wanted to cheer people up with a survivors' party this weekend.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of course... What's the favor?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe you could slip in a good word for our party when you take our photo?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It should be easy enough to add text to your pictures. You want it to be like a slogan?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! Exactly like a slogan! I'm thinking...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I don't know what I'm thinking.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I got it! It should say 'Come party with the Three Bro-Migos!'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Clever.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: But we should have something under it... Maybe 'Let's shake up your Friday night'?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I like where you're going with this guys, but the newspaper article is going to be a sympathetic piece.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It probably shouldn't involve an earthquake pun.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Surely the Three Bro-Migos can think of more slogans. Run them by me, and I'll say 'yes' or 'no'.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How about... 'Let's rock this school to its foundations!'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I can just add in some contrast lighting here, and maybe a slightly different tint on the entire thing.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You think it'd make us more cool?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, why not? It'll heighten the effect of the picture.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Won't that make us look more scared?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not more `scared.` Just more concerned.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not more [color=#e23b3b][i]scared.[/i][/color] Just more concerned.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, okay... That sounds nice.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't mind that at all.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You could really do that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of course. I could put in an ogre... Or a unicorn...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or a one-armed giant!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Or that.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Unless you think it'd look bad...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: No, I think it'd look silly. Playful. It would definitely make some people laugh.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And probably in a good way.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It'd go a long way in showing that your group has a sense of humor.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We don't need to be taken seriously all the time.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And especially not after they see this!
Nick works hard to sweep dust away and pushes rubble into a corner of the Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whew, this is harder work than I thought.
A short while later, Nick is trying to get dust off his hands when Megan comes up.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, cleaning?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No, you're not. You just put all the rubble into this corner.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I thought I'd consolidate it.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Are you blind? It needs to go to the dumpster outside!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Now Kenji and I have to go and carry `more` stupid rocks. Thanks a lot.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now Kenji and I have to go and carry [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] stupid rocks. Thanks a lot.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You're making more work for us, not less.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Just out. `Get out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just out. [color=#3b78e2][i]Get out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick hangs his head as he leaves...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Clearly, I wasn't meant for hard labor... At least I'm seeing the nerds tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They're probably not lifting heavy things...
After Ryan's photo shoot, Nick finds his way to the Auto-Shop.
It's a wreck! A chunk of the ceiling has collapsed, covering most of the room in heavy rubble and dust.
In the middle of everything, Megan and Kenji pick at the rubble, slowly sweeping the debris and dust off their shop.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't know if this is helping... It doesn't look like we're making much of a dent.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Keep talking like that, cuz, and I'll put a dent in your face. My second favorite bike's under there, and we're digging her out.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, hello?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I couldn't help but overhear... So you guys are cleaning up the Auto-Shop?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No, we're twirling in tutus... What do you `think` we're doing?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, nothing really. I wanted to get some photos for a newspaper article about the earthquake.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No way. I don't want you in here, mucking things up while Kenji and I bust our butts off cleaning.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And I don't like the idea of you taking any picture that makes Auto-Shop look bad.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It wouldn't make the Auto-Shop look bad...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You don't think so?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No. I think an image of the devastation of this place will inspire people to help.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Oh yeah. I'm sure they'll just come `running` to clean `this` place up...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay. Well, what if I help you?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: To give people hope.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I don't follow, Skinny Jeans.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm thinking of taking comparison shots.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I could take a picture now, help you clean up, and then do a picture afterwards.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: A before-and-after shot would give people hope that we can eventually return to our school. It'd make the Auto-Shop a positive model for the future.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, 'positive' in the sense that people will find the earthquake less devastating. Auto-Shop should still really try to focus more on creating vehicles that are less dependent on gasoline to run...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kid, word of warning... Shut up. Don't tell me how to run Auto-Shop, or I'll stuff you into a dumpster.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And you've convinced me. I'm not going to say 'no' to a volunteer... If you want your 'after' picture... You can start cleaning up over there at the back corner.
Nick takes a quick picture of the Auto Shop, then rolls up his sleeves and gets to work.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If I want those pictures...
The next afternoon, Nick walks into the arcade.
Near the snack bar, the nerds study for their greatest challenge yet...
An Ogres 'N' Elves tournament!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay, we're going to discuss proper battle protocol.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Erik, your character has just been asked to duel by the Head Wizard of the Arkanian Priori! What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Not 'yay'! Your character can't handle the spells developed by the Priori wizards! Only your response will save your life. So what do you say?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. Right. Uh... 'Thou Head Magician, I duly decline thou demand for due dueling'!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Excellent.
Dex turns to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Taylor, as a ranger, your character should never engage in an enemy known as the Dargonian. Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Because he attacks rangers?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He does something special?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Doesn't he... Doesn't he have some sort of attack I should look out for?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...Close enough. Just as long as you remember not to engage him. The specific attack is the 'Bowbreaker', and its use has proliferated since the release of the 4th Version of the handbook...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't stand next to the Dragon. Got it. Can we... Take a break now?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A break? Guys, this tournament is going to test the strengths and weaknesses of our team. We need to be ready!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: What's the point? Maybe before the earthquake, we had a real chance. What about now?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We can't break apart at the seams. So what if all our character sheets, handbooks, and fantastical hopes and dreams got caught in the school fire?

nodes.speaker: Erik

nodes.speaker: Dex

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey guys... Mind if I take a picture?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What for?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: For the school newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: You know, some ancient cultures believe that cameras capture your soul...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, not my soul!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I'm certainly not after that. It's for an article about the earthquake.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That doesn't sound like it'll hurt... What do we have to do?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I just want to see some insight into how people are feeling. The earthquake affected all of us.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You guys go ahead and take this one... I'll just be at the snack bar...
Nick gathers the nerds and poses them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Perfect. Okay... Think about how you felt when the earthquake happened.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Great, now just hold that...
Nick takes the picture and shows it to the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Eh.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Me neither.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: We look scared! Except for Erik. He just looks bewildered.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I didn't like thinking about that at all! I was inside my mind, but my mind was dark and scary... Like a dentist's office at night!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sorry you had to relive that, Erik. But... You guys `look` fine. I know the earthquake threw me for a loop, and that's what you're showing.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry you had to relive that, Erik. But... You guys [color=#e23b3b][i]look[/i][/color] fine. I know the earthquake threw me for a loop, and that's what you're showing.

nodes.text: It's not okay if the nerds look scared.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Think about what this picture could do to our rep!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Your... Rep? I think 'being scared' often comes with the territory, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But doesn't that just seem cliche? Isn't there some way we can look cool or funny or something better?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... Maybe if you make different faces...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I guess we're just doomed to look frightened.

nodes.text: Maybe I can help. I can do some post-production work on these photos...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That sounds cool! You mean, like adding effects and stuff?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah. I can change the background a little bit. Why don't I add...

Around the corner, some of the cheerleaders are coming up to Ryan and hugging him.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I saw your picture in the newspaper, and Denni wrote about how the earthquake hit some people really hard.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I'm so sorry...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ryan, I had no idea you could be so sad...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I just want you to know that the earthquake made us all think about our lives and what we could have done...
Nicole hugs him.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I will take your pity!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wonder if the nerds liked my edits...
Nick finds the nerds hanging out in front of a classroom.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, did you see the article?
Nick leaves the nerds and runs into Hector, $Scott, and Carson!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I feel like I did a good job... Working with the school newspaper and getting to interview people...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's like this is starting to feel like a place I belong to...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't wait to tell Sam...
Nick bursts into Twin Branches's new swimming center.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, Sam!
Nick runs in, but the hall is empty except for one swimmer perched on the side of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to interrupt you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's all right. I'm done.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So you're looking for Sam? She just went into the girls' locker room. She'll probably be out in a minute.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks. I guess I'll wait here. I'm Nick Brown, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sara Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh right. Your dad is the coach. Wasn't he a swimmer himself?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah. It's kind of the family trade.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha. I see. I've definitely seen your picture in the papers.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I have had my picture taken once or twice before.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe I should have taken some shots of you yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wow, that sounded extremely creepy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What I meant was that I should have taken pictures of the swim team for the newspaper.

nodes.text: That's actually why I'm here. To show Sam the work I've done. Do you want to see?

nodes.text: These are great!

nodes.text: It's kind of cool that you got so many different cliques to pose for it.

nodes.text: Yeah, I was pretty happy I pulled that off considering...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Considering what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm new here. I'm still trying to figure out where I fit in.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know how you feel. Even though I've been at this school since the beginning, it's still like I'm on the `outside.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know how you feel. Even though I've been at this school since the beginning, it's still like I'm on the [color=#3b78e2][i]outside.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That is exactly how I would put it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, at least there are two of us now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Nick. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let me guess. You have a date planned.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah. That and I have something to share with you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're... Nice. There are a lot of them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I got into it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Does this mean you'll get off my back about hanging out all the time?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha! Well, excuse me for wanting to `see` my girlfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Well, excuse me for wanting to [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] my girlfriend.

nodes.text: Nick kisses Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway, you ready to go? I haven't seen you these past few days... I kind of miss you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I believe you were saying something about a silent film...
Sam pulls Nick towards the door. He looks back one last time at Sara. She waves goodbye.
Looks like you helped Nick a bunch! He found his new place at Twin Branches, he gave Sam some space, and he found a new friend in Sara!
Congratulations! You've done a great job!

In swim class... Nick eyes the pool dubiously.

nodes.text: You know... I hate water... And swimming is not really my thing...
Sam pushes him in.

nodes.text: Erk! Help! I lied! I can't swim!

nodes.text_bbcode: And to think you're the one that rescued [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] from the lake.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe this isn't for you...
Sam jumps in after him.
Archery does not go as planned either.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You'd think someone who went to a prep school his entire life would know how to shoot a bow and arrow...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't worry. I think your instructor will forgive you eventually for putting an arrow through his windshield...

nodes.text: Pizza's up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, that's the fourth order you've messed up today... And they were all for me!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How about pizza number five?

nodes.text: So what did you find out this week? Did you discover a hobby you'd be interested in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, stop! I can't... I can't do this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I need someone else. Someone who's not clingy, or needy, and someone who has his own set of friends...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but... A guy who can't figure out how to spend time with himself is just not someone I'm interested in...
Sam walks away.

nodes.text: Though I really hope they'll repair the football field by the time graduation rolls around...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hate the thought of never getting to play on the field again.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Why is that an issue?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard is... Graduating this year.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Already?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. It's about time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, that was fast...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tell me about it. I don't know what I'm going to do without him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if he goes really far away?
$ZOE and Howard look forlornly down at the ground.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm sure, no matter the distance, you guys will be fine!
Sam nudges Nick and mouths the words 'say something' at him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah... Long distance relationships are...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Dude, did you guys read what she said about us?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I saw the picture... That's all I need to know...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: But listen...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: 'Though the tremendous loss of the earthquake was difficult to handle, many intrepid and resilient students are putting on a brave face...'

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha, awesome. See this brave face?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You don't even know she's talking about `you.` What about me?
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't even know she's talking about [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] What about me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm glad they liked it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you girls see the article in the newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All I saw was my awesome self glaring at the camera!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's perfect! Everyone's going to see my beautiful face next to the campaign article!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just liked the part where Denni wrote about what a rich range of emotions we all felt.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I just heard that I should become a model...
The girls twitter excitedly about the picture, and Nick smiles to himself.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, so that guy really did put us in the paper.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Pft. So? It's just a picture.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But it's nice. And that writer girl even said we were 'good models of the ways students can contribute to the rebuilding effort, a symbol of hope for the community'.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: She said that?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I don't know if I like being a model... But it's kind of a nice thing to think about.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, all right...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They seem happier...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We loved it! The unicorn was a really nice touch!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I printed out two copies of it! One to keep in my room, and the other to keep with me at all times!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I just can't believe we're celebrities now...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I liked the picture less than pi but more than calculus.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: More than calculus? High praise!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I got a good look at the draft of Denni's report before she sent it off to press.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The part where she says it's important to be able to laugh during hard times directly refers to our picture.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I feel really well represented.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's great to hear!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Nick, we saw the picture you put into the article...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, how's that working out for you guys?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Our Faceplace party page has been totally spammed with people wanting to come to our party!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's going to be epic!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hey, you should come!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll think about it...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! Anyway, we're out... The party planning awaits...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of course...
They walk away, talking logistics.
